components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #ecebe6); background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #ecebe6); font-family: var(--font, Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.22em; font-stretch: 125%; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 11px 36px 11px 18px; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: -1px; right: -1px; bottom: -1px; width: 14px; background: var(--red, #e0352b); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--ink, #ecebe6); color: var(--ground, #0a0a0a); } .ds-btn:hover::after, .ds-btn:focus-visible::after, .ds-btn:active::after { opacity: 1; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--red, #e0352b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, rgba(236,235,230,0.42)); background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2, #bdbcb6); font-family: var(--font, Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.22em; font-stretch: 125%; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 11px 18px; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--ink, #ecebe6); color: var(--ground, #0a0a0a); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--red, #e0352b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button

outline: none; } .ds-num { font-size: 44px; font-weight: 200; font-stretch: 125%; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; transition: color 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); filter: saturate(0.85) brightness(0.86); transition: filter 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-entry:hover .ds-thumb, .ds-entry:focus-visible .ds-thumb { filter: none; } .ds-title { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 500; font-stretch: 112%; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-meta { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-2, #bdbcb6); } .ds-meta strong { color: var(--ink, #ecebe6); font-weight: 500; } .ds-side { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 10px; } .ds-pts { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 300; font-stretch: 125%; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; width: 9px; height: 9px; background: #2a2a2a; } .ds-readout i.on { background: var(--ink, #ecebe6); transition: background-color 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-entry:hover .ds-readout i.on, .ds-entry:focus-visible .ds-readout i.on { background: var(--red, #e0352b); components.name: Colour Code Mark
components.description: Wordmark over the five-block industrial colour code.
components.css: .ds-logo { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; color: var(--ink, #ecebe6); text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font, Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-logo-text { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.28em; font-stretch: 125%; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-code { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-code i { display: block; width: 18px; height: 8px; } .ds-code i:nth-child(1) { background: var(--grey, #7a7a7a); } .ds-code i:nth-child(2) { background: var(--blue, #5b8cff); } .ds-code i:nth-child(3) { background: var(--yellow, #e8b923); } .ds-code i:nth-child(4) { background: var(--red, #e0352b); } .ds-code i:nth-child(5) { background: var(--ink, #ecebe6); }

narrative.overview:
The list is a record label's back catalogue printed on matte black. Every demon is a catalogue number, and the position numeral is the headline: an expanded, ultra-light Archivo figure that reads before anything else on the row. Everything around it is hairline: bone-white 1px rules, square boxes, no radius, no shadow. The surface feels printed and filed, not app-like.

Density is moderate and list-first. Rows are full-width hairline boxes stacked 12px apart; the #01 entry gets a featured sleeve with a 128px numeral and a large thumbnail. Labels speak in wide tracked caps, the "engraved" voice of the catalogue; body text stays plain sentence-case Archivo at 15px.

Colour is a code, not a decoration. A five-block industrial strip (grey, blue, yellow, red, white) under the wordmark is the mark, and each of those colours has one job across the whole app. The signature move is decoding: thumbnails sit in slightly muted colour at rest, and the hovered or focused entry resolves to full, saturated colour with a white border while its numeral turns red and its ten-cell points readout (white at rest) lights red. The #01 entry keeps its numeral red at all times and carries the five-block code strip.
keyCharacteristics: Matte black ground, bone-white ink, 1px hairline rules, zero radius, zero shadow.
Archivo variable with the width axis: expanded light numerals, wide tracked caps labels.
Position numeral is always the largest thing on an entry.
One job per colour: red = active/selected, yellow = progress %, blue = links/video, green = success only.
Decoding on hover/focus-within: greyscale to colour, ink numeral to red, 400ms ease-out.

rules.name: The One Job Rule
rules.body: Each signal colour has exactly one role. Red never marks progress, yellow never marks a link, blue never marks state. A new surface picks a role, not a colour.

rules.name: The Red Is State Rule
rules.body: Red appears only in response to active, selected, focused or decoding state, plus destructive admin actions. Nothing is red at rest except the active tab's edge block and the colour-code mark.

rules.name: The Numeral Leads Rule
rules.body: On any entry the position numeral is the largest, lightest type present. Nothing competes with it, including the name.

rules.name: The Width Carries Voice Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from width and tracking, not weight. Caps are always expanded (125%) and tracked (0.16em to 0.28em); body text is never widened.

rules.name: The Hairline Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is a stronger 1px rule or a step from ground to panel to raise. No box-shadow, no blur, no glow.

dos: Do make the position numeral the largest, lightest type on every entry (200 weight, 125% width).
Do keep thumbnails slightly muted at rest and push them to full colour with a red numeral and lit readout on hover and focus-within.
Do mark active and selected state with a solid red edge block flush to the right edge (10px tabs, 14px primary button).
Do give emphasis with the 42% hairline or a ground-to-panel-to-raise tone step.
Do set every label, button and header in expanded tracked caps (125% width, 0.16em to 0.28em).
Do limit motion to 200ms colour/fill changes and the 400ms ease-out decode, and drop all of it under reduced motion.
donts: Don't round corners or add shadows; every box is square and flat.
Don't use red at rest or for anything other than state, focus, decode or destructive actions.
Don't use yellow for anything but progress percentages, blue for anything but links and video, or green for anything but success.
Don't fill primary buttons with colour at rest; they are ink outlines that invert on hover.
Don't let a thumbnail sit in full colour at rest in a catalogue list.
